response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial or embedded systems, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ in a 2014 role at National Instruments; their recent work is overwhelmingly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no evidence of modern C++ STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial automation domain knowledge required for the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Proven track record in open-source and community-driven technical projects
Excellent documentation, teaching, and workshop leadership skills
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development experience in relevant domains
Lacks demonstrated exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or IoT protocols
Primary tech stack is web-focused (TypeScript/Node.js), not C++/embedded systems
